item.title: Matthew Kress rises to No. 1 as Florida hosts elite field at Gators Invitational
item.description: Golfer Matthew Kress rises from longshot to the No. 1 spot in the lineup as Florida chases seventh straight Gators Invitational title.

item.title: Orlando high school scores and statistics from Thursday, Feb. 12
item.description: In girls wrestling, Oviedo and Freedom won district titles. Nick Sande had 17 strikeouts in a complete game shutout for Umatilla baseball. Boys soccer region semifinal winners were West Orange, Seminole, Olympia, Windermere, South Lake, Gateway and Bishop Moore.

item.title: Professors in the Epstein files say they hoped friendship would lead to research funding
item.description: There were Nobel laureates and acclaimed authors. Pioneers of science and medicine. At least one was a college president. High-profile academics spun in Jeffrey Epstein’s orbit for years, even after he was convicted of sex crimes. Now, facing backlash, many say they were driven by a single factor: Epstein’s wealth.

item.title: Experts say screening tips in Nancy Guthrie’s disappearance is ‘tremendous’ and critical work
item.description: An Arizona sheriff’s department got more than 4,000 calls within 24 hours after the release of videos of a masked person on Nancy Guthrie’s porch. Many tips will be worthless. Others could have merit. Experts say one thing’s certain: They can’t be ignored.

item.title: Trump boasts of over $1.5B in political funds. How he chooses to spend it could rock the midterms
item.description: President Donald Trump has bragged about building a political war chest exceeding $1.5 billion — a staggering sum that he can wield at his whim to shape November’s midterms and the 2028 race to succeed him.

item.title: Sex workers at Nevada brothel fight for the first-ever unionization
item.description: Nevada is the only state where people can legally purchase sex, and now sex workers at one of the state’s oldest brothels are fighting to become the nation’s first to be unionized.

item.title: Journalist Don Lemon set to be arraigned in Minnesota church protest case
item.description: Former CNN host turned independent journalist Don Lemon is set to be arraigned in federal court in Minnesota on Friday along with four other defendants who were indicted for their alleged roles in disrupting a service at church where an Immigration and Customs Enforcement official was a pastor.

item.title: Shooting at South Carolina State University residence complex kills 2 and wounds 1
item.description: Two people are dead and one person wounded after a shooting at a South Carolina State University residential complex, the university said Thursday.

item.title: LeBron James becomes the oldest player to have a triple-double in NBA history
item.description: LeBron James became the oldest player in NBA history to have a triple-double, accomplishing the feat for the Los Angeles Lakers on Thursday night against the Dallas Mavericks.

item.title: Prosecutors move to dismiss charges against men accused of hitting ICE officer with broom and shovel
item.description: Federal prosecutors in Minneapolis have moved to drop felony assault charges against two Venezuelan men, including one shot in the leg by a immigration officer, after new evidence emerged undercutting the government’s version of events.
